bulk.title: Bulk device registration
bulk.clientFormatHint: One register group per line. Columns: host,port,unit_id,fc,address,count,data_type,polling_interval,comment (comma or tab — spreadsheet paste supported). A row with host (TCP) and unit_id (1-247) starts a new device; a row with all three identity cells (host/port/unit_id) blank appends a group to the previous device. fc 1-4 (1=coils 2=discrete_inputs 3=holding_registers 4=input_registers), address and count required. port (default 502), data_type (default uint16), polling_interval and comment optional. Header line auto-skipped.
bulk.gatewayFormatHint: One segment per line. Columns: unit_id,name,fc,address,count,data_type,comment (comma or tab). A row with unit_id (1-247) starts a new device; a row with both identity cells (unit_id/name) blank appends a segment to the previous device. fc 1-4, address and count required; name, data_type and comment optional. A shared segment inserts two cells shared,<shared_address> after data_type (e.g. ...,uint16,shared,200,description). At least one segment per device is required. Header line auto-skipped.
